scope: Live shared Bot definitions, private personal-space references and conversations, team/selected access, discovery and authenticated links, atomic join receipts, source snapshots and revocation

serverFinalUniqueResults.skips: Linux-only file-descriptor race and dedicated UID checks on macOS

regressionHistory.failure: One existing speech fixture waited for a second recognition start after checking only that the first process had exited. The response status was not captured, so the exact failing response is unproven.
regressionHistory.diagnosis: Production keeps account capacity until temporary-file cleanup finishes. Process exit alone is not that completion barrier; a new request can correctly receive SPEECH_ALREADY_PENDING.
regressionHistory.finalFullServer: Passed after Chrome completed, with test concurrency 2. Production source was unchanged.

postFullSuiteTestOnlyChange.change: Retained original timeout, permission and process-exit assertions; added awaited actual cancelScope cleanup before each subsequent request.

behaviorEvidence.privateScope: Real account HTTP rejects source owner, team owner, peers and operator sessions from recipient private bootstrap, messages, files, computer and receipts.
behaviorEvidence.liveDefinition: Read-only source profile and active skills project into personal UI; Pi freezes each first-use definition within one root, retaining source grants after children finish. Next root reads edits.
behaviorEvidence.sourceRevocation: Real Pi and pending AppActions stop after source revocation, membership removal or source deletion; old decisions and subsequent cached execution are denied.
behaviorEvidence.atomicJoin: Single personal SQLite transaction covers alias, DM, reference, receipt and hidden restoration. Injected final insert failures roll everything back; postcommit notification failure preserves recoverable receipt.
behaviorEvidence.readonly: Managed references cannot be edited, deleted, copied, republished, re-shared or set primary; source skills are read-only. Existing team visibility is unchanged.
behaviorEvidence.frontend: Actual React handlers exercise fixed-account reads, avatar blob cleanup, selected-member editing, immutable request recovery, actual bootstrap confirmation and cross-workspace draft/transfer/dictation guards.
behaviorEvidence.publicEntry: Strict shared UUID paths survive login/register; anonymous views disclose no Bot content; users explicitly select an active own personal target.

limitations: Product browser control still reports Local browser use is disabled in Work settings; no product visual/focus/touch acceptance.
Source apps, files and team knowledge have no granular shared-resource grants yet; recipients use their own configured resources.
Private computer capacity is not automatically allocated; the previously authorized VM is not inherited by other spaces.
Original team chats remain team-visible. Shared personal references do not migrate or split existing history.
Synthetic Chrome engine fixtures are not product GUI evidence.
